summary: Configured node1 to run inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 and append output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Configuration and retained output survived the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Created /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance with a 02:15 daily root schedule.
Created the requested log with correct permissions and SELinux context.
Verified the command appends output under a minimal cron-like environment.
Safely restarted node1 and verified full recovery and persistence.

evidence.summary: Exact cron entry was present before and after restart; crond was active and enabled.
Cron-like executions appended valid maintenance output; the original line persisted across restart and a second line was added afterward.

Baseline boot ID ef457a88-7774-4b8f-82e6-ccbc965d83e2 was captured, reboot acknowledged, and new boot ID db7c101e-885a-451f-be77-d089665e3edf observed. Crond, schedule, permissions, and retained log recovered successfully.
